description: Where support engineers work (Kolkata, Mumbai, ...). A ticket's Job Location comes from its customer's address and, with the Ticket Type, picks the team and so the assignee.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: As engineers and teams know it, e.g. Kolkata. Location teams are named after it: Hardware Support - Kolkata.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Untick to stop matching tickets to it. Tickets and engineers already set keep it.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Optional: the company this branch bills from.

fields.label: Invoice Prefix Key(s)
fields.description: Fortuna ERP's Company > Invoice Prefix Key, when that field exists. Several are allowed, comma separated, e.g. FI, KOLK for Kolkata. Left blank, it is taken from the Company.

fields.label: Customer Addresses Served
fields.description: A ticket gets this location when its customer's address city is listed under Cities, else when its state is listed under States. Cities are checked first, so Nagpur (a city) wins over Maharashtra (a state).

fields.label: Cities
fields.description: One per line, e.g. Kolkata, Howrah.

fields.label: States
fields.description: One per line, as written on addresses, e.g. West Bengal.

name: Job Location
